ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... Drawer 8 holds the Germany file. ... Drawer 1 holds the Syria file. ... Drawer 2 holds the Indonesia file. ... Which drawer holds the file on the country whose capital is Damascus?" -> answer org 1; the alt prompt asks about the Indonesia (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: 2 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 8 (answer at the same statement slot), 3 (the alt prompt's own answer), 1 (answer org kept).
